stem.text: The formula of a solid magnesium compound is $\text{Mg(NO}_3\text{)}_2\text{.6H}_2\text{O}$. When the solid compound is heated in a hard-glass test-tube, one or more changes are observed.

items: Strong heating produces a basic residue.
Strong heating produces a brown gas.
Gentle heating produces colourless droplets of liquid on the upper parts of the test-tube.
